horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Monairue Jitoma y Nofïda Jitoma. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P20 — Nofïda / Nopïda Jitoma. Nofïda / Nopïda Jitoma: lean young man with elongated cheekbones, wide lips, heavy natural brows, straight shoulder black hair. HALF-HEIGHT emerald ring with a SINGLE long cobalt feather to rear, no huge fan. Small black-seed earrings, short red/black seed neck strand, narrow cream bark cover with one charcoal irregular edge. No nasal ornament. One red chest stripe and two fine black cheek curves. Green / cobalt identity, distinct from the father red tuft and brother yellow/blue swept plume.
Reference 2: P21 — Fïzido / Iaijenima. Fïzido / Iaijenima: shorter slim youthful adult, rounded wide-cheek face, fuller lips, straight chin-length black hair with uneven blunt fringe. A LOW swept-back feather comb of three cobalt and TWO golden feathers, slender pale QUILL nasal ornament and ONE short red/black seed neck strand. Narrow cream bark front/back flaps, plain cord. A short charcoal cheek stroke and small pale upper-arm paper stripe. Playful lively natural expression, not a smirk caricature, blue / yellow identity.
Reference 3: L02 — Chagra — claros, cultivos y recorridos. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide cool dawn chagra with fallen cut timber, plant beds and a quiet whole small bird perched on a low root. TWO whole brothers match P20 Nofïda with green ring/single cobalt rear feather and P21 Fïzido with low cobalt/yellow swept comb and small pale nasal quill. They crouch separately to examine one old full blowpipe left beside masculine work traces, not a skull or corpse. The bird's shadow becomes a faint complete adult hunter silhouette on the earth as an ORIGINAL EDITORIAL visualization of the animal revealing the father's story; no physical third person or ghost. Quiet investigation, not random combat. Both brothers distinct, whole feet and ornaments inside, world dominant.

VISIBLE CHECK: Dos hermanos distintos leen señales; sombra de ave sugiere al padre ausente.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Restore ONLY the small pale horizontal NASAL QUILL on Nofïda, matching reference 2 P20. Place its near tip visibly at the nostril base against brown skin, extending slightly across the nose. Keep the quiet face, whole crouching body, single blue feather, egg-heart, hands, chagra floor and landscape unchanged. Do not add a headdress, duplicate the character or alter clothes. Reference 2 is an identity sheet only, never copy its layout.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Monairue Jitoma y Nofïda Jitoma. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: V12 — Fïzido: huevo y restitución. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE small whole HUMMINGBIRD EGG, cream matte paper with a small delicately lifted opening, casts TWO distinct complete HUMAN SHADOWS side by side: one steady longer figure and one shorter lively figure. This is an original editorial metaphor for a saved heart allowing the complementary brothers to continue, not a real tiny person or two separate eggs. Whole egg, entire paired shadow on one ochre ground plane, quiet deep green border. No skull, blood, wings on humans, glyphs, extra props, realistic embryo or infant.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un huevo entero sostiene dos sombras humanas distintas.
